queries.query: large language model AND "network configuration" OR "network config" generation OR synthesis OR "intent-to-configuration"
queries.rationale: Find direct work using LLMs to generate network configurations or translate operator intent to configs (core phenomenon).

queries.query: LLM OR "large language model" AND "configuration repair" OR "repair" AND network OR NetOps
queries.rationale: Capture work on generate–validate–repair loops and automated configuration correction for NetOps.

queries.query: "generate-validate-repair" OR "generate-then-validate" OR "validator-assisted" AND (LLM OR "language model") AND network
queries.rationale: Target papers proposing or evaluating architectures combining generation and formal or heuristic validators for network tasks (mechanisms and mitigations).

queries.query: Batfish OR Veriflow OR Minesweeper OR "NetPlumber" OR "network verification" AND (LLM OR "language model" OR "tool-assisted")
queries.rationale: Locate intersections between formal network-verification tools and LLM-driven workflows or tool-calling agents (validator integration and benchmark/validation methods).

queries.query: "agentic" OR "agent" OR "autonomous agent" AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (NetOps OR network OR "network operations")
queries.rationale: Survey agentic/autonomous orchestration frameworks applying LLMs to NetOps and associated safety/trust concerns (agent mechanisms, orchestration frameworks).

queries.query: LLM hallucination OR "hallucinations" OR incorrect OR "misconfiguration" AND network OR NetOps
queries.rationale: Identify failure modes where model output produces invalid or unsafe network configurations (phenomenon and failure analysis).

queries.query: AIOps benchmark OR "NetOps benchmark" OR "network operations benchmark" OR "6G-Bench" OR "TSNBench" OR "OpsEval"
queries.rationale: Find existing benchmarks and evaluation suites used for AIOps/NetOps to assess benchmark relevance and gaps (benchmark validity).

queries.query: benchmark validity OR "ecological validity" OR "construct validity" OR "external validity" AND (AIOps OR NetOps OR LLM)
queries.rationale: Retrieve methodological critique and meta-analyses about benchmark validity and applicability to operational NetOps (benchmark validity, threats).

queries.query: prompt injection OR "adversarial prompts" OR "malicious prompts" AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (network OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Search for adversarial and security threats specific to prompting LLMs used in network operation pipelines (threat mechanisms and mitigations).

queries.query: tool use OR "tool-augmented" OR "API-calling" OR "LLM tool" AND (network OR CLI OR "network CLI" OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Find work on LLMs using external tools (CLIs, APIs, simulators) for NetOps tasks and how tool integration affects correctness and reproducibility (mechanisms, methods).

queries.query: human-in-the-loop OR "operator-in-the-loop" OR "human oversight" AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (NetOps OR network)
queries.rationale: Survey studies on human supervision, approval workflows, and mixed-initiative validation for LLM-based NetOps (mitigations and operational trust).

queries.query: evaluation metrics OR "success criteria" OR "safety metrics" OR "correctness metrics" AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (network OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Collect proposed metrics and evaluation methodologies suitable for measuring operational correctness, safety, robustness of LLM outputs in NetOps (methods, benchmark design).

queries.query: LLM code generation OR Codex OR "code LLM" AND (network configuration OR "network automation" OR Ansible OR "network scripts")
queries.rationale: Find related work from code-generation LLM literature applied to network automation and configuration scripting (neighbouring work and transfer of methods).

queries.query: network simulator OR Mininet OR NS-3 OR "network emulation" AND evaluation OR benchmarking AND (LLM OR automation OR "NetOps agent")
queries.rationale: Discover simulation/emulation environments used to evaluate NetOps actions so as to assess realism and how to validate LLM outputs (methods and experimental infrastructure).

queries.query: "related work" OR survey OR "systematic review" AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (AIOps OR NetOps OR "network operations")
queries.rationale: Locate surveys and systematic reviews to build a comprehensive neighbourhood view and to ensure fast coverage of existing literature and gaps.

inclusion_criteria: Primary sources (conference/journal papers, arXiv preprints, technical reports) with verifiable bibliographic metadata
Work explicitly addressing LLMs or foundation models applied to network configuration, automation, repair, or NetOps workflows
Papers proposing or evaluating generate–validate–repair, tool-assisted, or agentic pipelines in operational contexts
Studies that present empirical evaluation, metrics, simulators/emulators, or reproducible artifacts (code/datasets) when available
Benchmarks, critiques, or methodological work on evaluation validity, safety metrics, or robustness relevant to NetOps
Security/adversarial analyses relevant to prompting, tool use, or agentic behavior in network contexts
Human-in-the-loop or governance/oversight mechanisms for LLM-driven NetOps
Publicly accessible project pages or GitHub repos for tools (Batfish, Mininet, etc.) used as primary evidence
exclusion_criteria: Non-English publications without an English abstract or translation
Marketing materials, vendor blog posts, product one-pagers lacking verifiable technical claims
Papers not focused on network operations, network configuration, or operations-relevant automation (e.g., purely NLP benchmarking unrelated to NetOps)
Works without verifiable bibliographic metadata or unverifiable claims (avoid fabricated/untraceable citations)
Private, proprietary, or NDA-restricted datasets or results not publicly accessible (unless a public technical report summarizes them)
Older background literature predating core concepts unless clearly seminal to network verification (exclude dated obsolescent engineering notes)
date_rationale: Prioritize literature from 2018–2026 to cover the LLM/foundation-model era and rapid recent advances, while allowing inclusion of earlier seminal network-verification and simulator work (pre-2018) when explicitly foundational to verification or NetOps evaluation.
